transaction_manifest.title: DeepSeek native Harness pragmatic development-adoption review closeout

node.title: DeepSeek native Harness pragmatic development-adoption review and plan

notes: Yuri explicitly requested that perfect clockwork/native-Harness interoperability cease to be the admission standard and that retained know-how be used to enter real development with minimum further stand-alone testing.
The review itself remains provider-free and read-only; occupied worker authority begins only in the separately latched successor.
DeepSeek is a monitored secondary worker, not the default or its own acceptance authority.

decisions.summary: Admit the pinned native Harness for bounded real EMR4 implementation work without another generic boot or interoperability qualification tranche, while declining default promotion.
Accept materially stronger traceability while retaining that useful EMR4 completion and comparative reliability versus Claude Code remain unproved.
Keep pinned enclosure, broker, tool, trace, cleanup and Sol acceptance controls; retire generic boot reproof, one-request containment, per-step ticks and diagnostic sequels.
Select one unmounted non-secret canonical check-in manifest-normalizer source/test package as the first monitored real assignment.
Accept a zero-additional-rehearsal development-entry plan, 53 deterministic passes and nine contained local evidence/closeout-command lapses without another reusable control layer.

claim_scope: Sixty-eight accepted native-Harness Continuity nodes and seventy-one closeouts were reviewed as retained non-protected evidence.
The accepted stock-headless-to-custom-runner boot prerequisite already passed and requires no generic reproof while exact hashes remain pinned.
The native Harness is admitted as a monitored secondary worker and is not the default worker.
Native traceability is materially stronger than the retained Claude-Code failure evidence, but superior useful-task reliability is not proved.
The first real assignment owns only closed_manifest_normalizer as unmounted authored-reference-only EMR4 source and focused tests.
No Harness, provider, product, data, runtime, deployment, release, Pages or protected-ref action occurred during the review.
unresolved_gates: Useful native-Harness completion on real EMR4 source remains unproved until a candidate passes Sol review and focused tests.
Default-worker promotion remains closed and depends on matched real-work readings rather than raw incident counts.
The typed operational-evidence inputs and pure environment evidence-gate evaluator remain later repository nodes.
The check-in admission seam, ordinary-practice activation and every external operational fact or human selection remain closed.
No product data, production runtime, deployment, release, Pages or protected integration is open.

journey.strategic_role: Move the native DeepSeek Harness from an over-qualified integration subject into useful bounded Raisa development
journey.outcome: The accepted controls are reduced to the gears needed for traceability, containment and Sol acceptance, and the first real assignment is selected.

current_position.strategic_role: Use the native Harness on one small genuine EMR4 source/test package and measure accepted usefulness plus correction cost
current_position.why_now: The boot, tool and trace boundaries are already accepted, and another synthetic qualification phase would answer less than a real bounded assignment.
current_position.outcome: One fresh native-Harness session will attempt the unmounted closed manifest normalizer with natural multi-turn self-correction and Sol-owned tests.
unlocks: A matched useful-candidate reading rather than another boot coordinate.
Practical evidence of whether stronger traceability reduces orchestrator recovery cost.
The first of a rolling set of real-work readings that can support continued use or later promotion.
does_not_solve: One run cannot prove general reliability or default-worker suitability.
The unmounted normalizer does not create an operational manifest, resolve a secret or enable ordinary practice.
No product data, live product runtime, deployment, release or protected integration is opened.
current_position.orientation_statement: The clockwork will take pre-dispatch and terminal readings while the native Harness is allowed to perform ordinary multi-turn coding inside one bounded session.

next_operation.active_tranche: Native Harness first pragmatic real-development run: canonical check-in manifest normalizer
next_operation.objective: Freeze the exact unmounted closed manifest-normalizer contract and minimal scaffold, then let one fresh pinned native-Harness session implement only that source/test package with natural multi-turn self-correction, Sol-owned deterministic tests and terminal trace/cleanup readback.
next_operation.authority_source: Yuri explicitly requested pragmatic native-Harness entry into real EMR4 development with minimum further rigorous testing, and the accepted adoption plan selects this bounded first assignment under standing uninterrupted-development authority.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: PowerShell loop output is materialized before it enters a pipeline.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: A pipeline was placed directly after a foreach block and PowerShell rejected an empty pipe element before the summary ran.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: PowerShell returned a parser error before producing evidence or changing state.

correction.action: Assign the foreach result to an array and pipe the array.
correction.prevention_control: PowerShell loop summaries materialize the collection before sorting or selecting.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one corrected PowerShell foreach-pipeline parse error.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Windows ripgrep searches use explicit files or valid directory roots.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: A read-only evidence search supplied a Windows-invalid wildcard path.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Ripgrep rejected the wildcard target with no file change.

correction.action: Replace the wildcard target with a valid directory-scoped search.
correction.prevention_control: Use explicit files or literal directory roots for Windows ripgrep.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one corrected Windows-invalid Harness evidence search.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The tool-call JavaScript parses before invoking a read-only PowerShell command.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first file-size inventory composer contained an unmatched parenthesis.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The tool wrapper returned a JavaScript syntax error before PowerShell invocation.

correction.action: Rebuild the command from an explicit quoted path array.
correction.prevention_control: Prefer short explicit tool-call composition over nested interpolation.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one corrected tool-call composer parenthesis error.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Nested JavaScript and PowerShell strings contain no unescaped language delimiter.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The corrected composer embedded a PowerShell backtick tab escape inside a JavaScript template literal.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The tool wrapper returned a JavaScript syntax error before PowerShell invocation.

correction.prevention_control: Use character codes rather than backticks in nested JavaScript/PowerShell tool calls.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one corrected nested JavaScript/PowerShell escape error.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The canonical Continuity graph path is discovered before it is searched.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The search named a nonexistent ariadne-continuity-graph directory instead of the canonical graph file.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Ripgrep returned a missing-path error while leaving the repository unchanged.

correction.action: List the Continuity root and read emr4-continuity-graph.json directly.
correction.prevention_control: Discover exact graph paths with a root file listing before structured reads.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one corrected Continuity graph path assumption.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Structured values are converted to strings before display concatenation.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: PowerShell treated a parsed DateTime as the left concatenation operand and tried to coerce the status string to TimeSpan.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The formatter returned twelve MethodException rows without changing evidence.

correction.action: Cast every chronology field to string before concatenation.
correction.prevention_control: Display summaries normalize structured values to strings first.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one corrected PowerShell DateTime display-coercion error.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The corrected explicit-file or directory-scope search form remains in use throughout the tranche.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The Windows-invalid wildcard path pattern recurred during the API-manifest source pass.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Ripgrep returned a nonzero invalid-target error after reading the explicit valid paths.

correction.action: Return to explicit files and valid directory roots for the remaining source pass.
correction.prevention_control: No wildcard is passed as a Windows ripgrep path argument.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one contained recurrence of the invalid Windows wildcard search.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The exact accepted operation layout is listed before reading a nested closeout artifact.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first read omitted the predecessor's closeout subdirectory and targeted a nonexistent root-level closeout-intent path.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Get-Content returned PathNotFound and no state changed.

correction.action: List the operation directory and read closeout/closeout-intent.json.
correction.prevention_control: Discover nested closeout artifacts from exact directory listings before reads.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one corrected closeout-intent subdirectory omission.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A transactional Continuity node contains exactly one builds_on relationship.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first closeout intent encoded the active predecessor plus two historical evidence nodes as three builds_on relationships.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The idempotent clockwork check rejected tick_transaction_manifest/node_relationship_invalid before canonical mutation.

correction.action: Retain only the active predecessor as builds_on and keep historical Harness nodes in decision evidence.
correction.prevention_control: Transactional closeout nodes use exactly one active predecessor relationship; other lineage remains ordinary evidence.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one rejected multi-parent Continuity node and exact one-parent correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every incident stage is selected from the clockwork's closed INCIDENT_STAGES vocabulary.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The corrected closeout intent still used five descriptive stage labels outside the closed vocabulary.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The second idempotent clockwork check rejected tick_incident_stage before canonical mutation.

correction.action: Map all review and closeout assembly incidents to the admitted closeout stage.
correction.prevention_control: Select incident stage values directly from the clockwork's closed INCIDENT_STAGES set.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one rejected descriptive-stage vocabulary set and its typed closeout-stage correction.
